`statement:` and `proof:` both track the same thing for their respective tab: whether the tex write-up has been checked against its corresponding Lean artifact in `lean/`, and by whom. Set each to exactly one of the following (used verbatim as the listing-table cell value too), and mirror the same value in the bullets above:

- `<span class='cj-badge cj-badge-open'>○ Open</span>` — no Lean artifact exists yet (for `proof`, this is the normal state for every unresolved conjecture).
- `<span class='cj-badge cj-badge-ai'>AI</span>` — autoformalized by an AI, not yet checked by a human. Name the AI model on the Formal Artifact tab (e.g. "autoformalized by Claude Sonnet 5").
- `<span class='cj-badge cj-badge-human'>Human</span>` — formalized and checked by a human (AI assistance along the way is fine; the human did the formalizing and the checking).
- `<span class='cj-badge cj-badge-aih'>AIH</span>` — autoformalized by an AI, then checked by a human. Name the AI model on the Formal Artifact tab, same as above.
:::
